title: Amelia | Patchwork Daisy Blouse with Playful Charm
bodyHtml:
Soft pastels and cheerful florals come together in this patchwork blouse that's equal parts whimsical and wearable. Mixing delicate floral prints, gingham checks, and oversized daisies, Amelia brings a touch of playful charm to your everyday wardrobe. Perfect for warm days or layering through cooler evenings, it's the kind of piece that makes getting dressed feel effortless.

Why you'll love it

  • Patchwork design combining florals, checks, and daisies in soft pink pastels—no two outfits will feel the same
  • Light and breathable fabric that doesn't cling, so you stay comfortable all day
  • Relaxed button-down fit that skims without restricting your movement
  • Pairs beautifully with white trousers, light denim, or linen shorts for instant weekend polish
  • The kind of feminine detail that works just as well dressed down with basics as it does styled up for lunch
  • Easy to care for—machine wash cold and hang to dry
